name: Photo Culler native macOS UX
verification: scripts/qa-ui.sh runs the app's own native window/action/accessibility checks and captures states for visual review; pcqa covers state/flow regressions. Browser-only product-gate is not applicable. A human VoiceOver or physical keyboard audit is not claimed.

design.purpose: Open a shoot, find keepers, inspect detail, and persist decisions without losing context.
design.appearance: Preserve beige and standard themes; use semantic primary/secondary text, compact native controls, visible focus, and consistent functional action names.
design.hierarchy: Toolbar actions; folder and progress status; image workspace; filmstrip; a scrolling inspector for photo decisions and catalog filters.
design.accessibility: Named native controls, visible labels and status, non-color selection indicators, native Tab outside compare, reduced-motion support. No truncated action copy.

screens.recovery: Open folder, retry folder, or clear filters as appropriate.
Select a photo or reset filters. Ratings, labels and filters expose accessible names and values.
Edit a local draft; Cancel discards only the draft; Save and close waits for persistence, leaves errors visible and allows retry.
Name missing configuration before start; distinguish primary/backup outcomes; Stop and Done remain available.

flows.expect: Filtered empty differs from first run; Clear filters restores file types/rating/colors/reject visibility while preserving sort and pair preference.
Save and close writes the captured current photo, flushes writes, and dismisses only on success; retry submits even after a failed optimistic cache update.
Cancel changes neither workspace metadata nor disk.
Tab passes to native focus outside compare, cycles panes inside compare; existing digits, navigation and text/modal exclusions remain intact.
Source and primary required; enabled backup/template/rename must be configured; destination paths must be distinct and outside the source.

omissions.offline: Local filesystem app; no network requirement.
omissions.roles: One local user; filesystem failures use the error states.
omissions.voiceOver: Verify native accessibility semantics; do not claim a human VoiceOver or assistive-device audit.
